title: Completely Changed For the Worse From the Vellux Blankets of the Past. Thin and Poor Quality
text:
Completely Changed For the Worse From the Vellux Blankets of the Past. Thin and Poor Quality. It is so upsetting that the so-called Vellux Original Blanket here is not the original Vellux of the old days I loved. This blanket is so thin. It does not provide the same warmth as the ones of the old days. It smells right out the package. It is not soft right out of the package like the ones of the old days.

I washed it right away to try and get the smell out and make it softer. It helped a tiny bit, but the blanket just does not have the insulating properties of the Vellux of the old days. The company changed it considerably, and not for the better.

The quality and effectiveness are very poor on this blanket.

I would never recommend this blanket now as is, and it doesn't look promising that the company will ever return to the older and vastly superior way of making these.

Save your money and time and avoid this blanket.
